title: PlurVA-LLM-2026 Shared Task Track-1: Pluralistic Value Alignment in LLMs via Multilingual Fine-Tuning and Threshold Calibration
reasoning: The paper focuses on pluralistic value alignment in Large Language Models across multiple cultures. It utilizes datasets like D2VBench, Pancasila-Dilemmas, and LKValues, which benchmark how models handle culturally grounded societal values, human preferences, and everyday ethical/value dilemmas.
